name: shoot.reply
description: A crew member's answer to the invite, as Lark reports it: going, can't, or none.
sql:
with answered as (update brandbase.crew c set reply = :reply where c.id = :crewId and c.shoot_id = :id returning c.*)
select brandbase.shoot_json(to_jsonb(s), coalesce((select jsonb_agg(z.c) from (
  select to_jsonb(c) as c from brandbase.crew c where c.shoot_id = s.id and c.id not in (select id from answered)
  union all select to_jsonb(a) from answered a) z), '[]')) as result
from brandbase.shoots s where s.id = :id and s.brand_id = :brand
